GSI Service Delivery Program Manager

 

Location: Bangalore, India

Job summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled and customer-focused Services Program Manager to develop a post-sales enablement and service-delivery quality framework for Rubrik’s Global System Integrator (GSI) partners.  Success in this role guarantees consistent and successful service delivery from Rubrik’s largest and most complex GSI partners to ensure customer success, satisfaction, and retention worldwide.   Pro-active and assertive development of the partner services relationships is a critical success factor for this role. It is both strategic and tactical and requires clear operational oversight, strong partner advocacy, and an ability to incent and reward top performance from Rubrik SMEs at all levels within the partners’ organizations.  The ideal candidate understands how to work effectively with the Partner’s organization in collaboration with Rubrik’s Sales and Service Delivery teams to make Rubrik the preferred vendor for easy enablement and adoption of Rubrik best practices to deliver high value and margin-rich services to their largest and most complex customers.

The GSI Services Program Manager is a critical contributor in the Partner Services Operations team within Rubrik’s Global Customer Success organization.  Partner Services Operations enables partners to deliver post-sales support and services to their customers using reliable and innovative systems, processes and programs that ensure a high level of Customer Satisfaction with minimal dependence on Rubrik.  The ideal candidate will have strong technical acumen, excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and a passion for collaborating with and advocating for partners for the benefit of our mutual customers.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Program Leadership & Management: Lead and coordinate a scalable high-growth engine of post-sales support and professional services GSI engineers.  Motivate this strategic workforce to achieve high Rubrik standards in product knowledge and service quality.
  • Partner Collaboration: Build and maintain strong relationships with GSI partners and their Rubrik account teams, acting as the primary point of contact for post-sales service issues, escalations, and proactive management of a seamless hand-off from sales to services.  Must be able to navigate and present to all management levels within the partner and Rubrik organization.
  • Customer Satisfaction: Maintain strong customer focus to ensure all managed partners are delivering world-class customer services, in collaboration with Rubrik, by measuring and monitoring customer satisfaction.
  • Training & Enablement: Facilitate and track role-based training and certification to GSIs that ensures they are well-equipped to deliver services aligned with Rubrik’s company standards, in partnership with Rubrik University, Rubrik Sales, and Global Customer Success.
  • Process & Quality Improvement: Implement and refine processes for support and professional services delivery, promoting best practices, scalability, and eliminating friction and inefficiencies. 
  • Metrics & Reporting: Develop and maintain program KPIs, track performance metrics, and prepare regular reports for executive leadership and stakeholders. Facilitate Services QBRs to ensure continuous improvement on both sides of the partnership.  Analyze program quality metrics to correctly assess and incent high partner performance, while requiring non-performers to improve or exit the program.
  • Partner Advocacy: Comprehensively understand the partners’ go-to-market strategy, global support structure, and service delivery plan; document and present partner’s approach to internal key stakeholders as an advocate for what the partners need from Rubrik to be successful.
  • Support Oversight: Provide oversight on partner’s open support cases and product gaps, to ensure timely resolution and appropriate resourcing and visibility within Rubrik.  Facilitate resolution for any customer complaints regarding partner-delivered services. 

 

ABOUT YOU:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in program management, operations, technical support, or professional services, in a customer-facing role at an enterprise technology solution provider.
  • Strong technical background and aptitude in Networking, Storage, Backup and Recovery, Cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP etc.), and Hypervisors (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.). Cyber Security experience is desired. 
  • Demonstrated experience working with GSIs or large multi-regional channel partners. Quickly understands the business issues, data challenges, and both the commercial and services aspects of strategic partnerships within global service delivery teams.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with excellent communication and presentation ability, specifically to summarize complex product issues into clear executive summaries.
  • Strong project management background, with demonstrated success coordinating multiple programs, workstreams, and people toward common, measurable objectives.
  • Highly detail-oriented with strong analytical skills, including hands-on experience analyzing customer data to facilitate data-driven decisions and to develop executive presentations. Experience with Salesforce, Atlassian, and Tableau reporting and data preferred.
  • Motivated, proactive self-starter with a customer-centric mindset, focused on delivering measurable outcomes from cross-functional teams, including those outside direct influence.
  • Able to work independently in a fast-paced growth environment.
  • Able to travel to other locations and customer sites on occasion as required.
  • Able to adjust work hours to overlap with USA and EMEA business hours as required.

Membership Coordinator

GENERAL INFORMATION

IS THIS YOU?

• 

Do your friends and family consistently come to you for advice on organization?

• 

When going on a road trip, are you the one with the directions, playlist, and backup plan ready in the passenger seat?

• 

Do your friends make fun of you for your checklists, color-coded calendars, or goal-tracking obsession?

• 

Is Mel Robins at the top of your podcast playlist?

• 

Do micro-managers give you the ick?

• 

Are you the friend who remembers birthdays, sends thoughtful follow-up messages, and keeps everyone in the loop? 

• 

Are you the person who reads the entire instruction manual before assembling something, then teaches everyone else how to do it? 

• 

Have people in your life been mildly annoyed with you because of your incessant follow-up and “just confirming” messages?

• 

Have you ever caught an error in a shared document that everyone else missed?

• 

Do you get a little bothered when files are saved in the wrong folder or named inconsistently?

• 

Are you looking for a company that acknowledges your independence and rewards you accordingly?

ROLE PURPOSE

We are a global educational company, and our mission is to harness the power of coaching worldwide. We achieve this through our Coaching Enablement Platform, offering a comprehensive suite of services designed to support and accelerate coaches' development. Our services include the Coaching Center of Excellence (a hub for professional development and education), Coaching Management Software, and Coaching Marketplace. Through these platforms, we empower coaches to shape their skills and have a profound impact on human life.

As a Membership Coordinator, you will play a vital role in managing and coordinating various aspects of our membership programs and community engagement initiatives. This role is ideal for a proactive, confident and detail-oriented individual who is passionate about supporting professional development and fostering a sense of community among our members.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

Within the first 90 days, the Membership Coordinator will:

• 

Deliver recurring membership communications, reminders, session logistics, and follow-ups accurately and on schedule.

• 

Maintain timely, transparent communication with members, facilitators, speakers, and Membership team.

• 

Ensure all session links, registration/access settings, automations, and resources are tested before they are shared externally.

• 

Maintain complete, accurate, and accessible program records, reports, and SOPs.

• 

Proactively flag risks, blockers, unclear ownership, or missed deadlines before they affect members or facilitators.

• 

Establish a clear, consistent operating rhythm so the Membership Manager and Director always have visibility into progress and confidence that work is complete and accurate.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Membership Coordinator reports directly to the Membership Manager & Membership Director to support the delivery training and education to our Members.

Your main responsibility is to support, coordinate and execute membership delivery administrative tasks, ensuring agreed program milestones are met. The role also has a specific focus on managing volunteer facilitators, hosting and providing technical support on live sessions, and coordinating the monthly newsletter. 

• 

Membership Project Management:

• 

Own the day-to-day coordination of assigned membership programs, projects, communications, and recurring administrative workflows.

• 

Build, maintain, and update project plans, task lists, deadlines, owners, dependencies, and status updates in Asana.

• 

Ensure every assigned task has a clear owner, deadline, intended outcome, and documented completion status.

• 

Provide daily updates on weekly priorities, progress, risks, blockers, and next steps in the designated Membership team channel or project-management system.

• 

Schedule meetings; prepare agendas, materials, and links; capture decisions and action items; and distribute follow-up notes promptly.

• 

Maintain an accurate membership operations calendar covering sessions, facilitator commitments, speaker commitments, member communications, reminders, deadlines, and follow-up requirements.

• 

Identify repetitive manual work and recommend or implement approved automations to improve accuracy, timeliness, and efficiency.

• 

Membership Delivery:

• 

Collaborate with the Membership Team on delivery, design & development processes.

• 

Acknowledge all member, facilitator, speaker, and internal emails within 24–48 business hours, even when a full resolution requires more time. 

• 

Escalate sensitive member issues, complaints, refund/payment concerns, access problems, or unresolved requests to the Membership Manager promptly. 

• 

Coordinate the operational delivery of membership sessions, coaching circles, learning experiences, workshops, and summits. 

• 

Complete quality assurance before any member-facing launch or send, including testing registration links, access permissions, invite links, reminders, automations, quiz links, recordings, and resource downloads in a test account where applicable. 

• 

Coordinate and compile new member and cancellation data, ensuring timely and relevant information is shared across teams.

• 

Support the delivery of live membership sessions on Zoom, including session support, session hosting, logistical coordination, scheduling and content preparation.

• 

Upload, title, tag, and publish recordings and resources in the Membership Resource and Recording Library in Circle according to established standards. 

• 

Update SOPs promptly whenever a workflow, platform, automation, communication sequence, or ownership model changes. 

• 

Assist with general administrative tasks related to membership management, including summit coordination, member database maintenance, and documentation.

• 

Hosting coverage when needed.

• 

Facilitator Coordination:

• 

Manage and coordinate volunteer facilitators, allocating sessions, being their point of contact and ensuring they are well-prepared for the sessions they are facilitating. 

• 

Maintain complete facilitator records, including session assignment, attendance, feedback, completed reports, outstanding actions, and follow-up needs. 

• 

Collect, review, and file session and facilitator reports for completeness, accuracy, and required follow-up before closing them. 

• 

Speaker Coordination:

• 

Support the Membership Director with speaker research, outreach, booking, scheduling, confirmation, preparation, and post-event follow-up. 

• 

Send and track speaker invitations, calendar holds, confirmation emails, reminder emails, asset requests, biographies, headshots, slides, workbooks, and handouts.

• 

Ensure speaker materials meet our standards before publication and are stored in the correct central location.

• 

Coordinate collection of testimonials, speaker thank-yous, post-session feedback, and all required follow-up communications.

KEY COMPETENCIES

Ownership and follow-through

You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. You close loops, verify delivery, track follow-up, and do not consider work complete until the intended result has been achieved.

You’re proactive

You keep the team informed without being asked. You surface risks early, seek clarification, communicate delays immediately, and propose a recovery plan when a problem arises.

Detail and quality orientation

You are meticulous with links, access, dates, time zones, lists, group assignments, reports, and member communications. You use checklists and testing to prevent avoidable errors.

Description

Join Alexa Connections and Revolutionize How the World Connects!

Are you ready to shape the future of voice-driven communication? The Contacts team within Alexa Connections is seeking exceptional Software Development Engineers to join our dynamic, multi-faceted team. We're not just any tech team – we're the innovators behind Alexa's contact management capabilities, tackling everything from static algorithms to large-scale systems. Our work directly impacts millions of Alexa users worldwide, and we're at the forefront of integrating LLMs to create more natural voice experiences. If you're passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible in voice technology, this is your chance to make a real difference.

As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll be immersed in a world of diverse technical challenges. Your mission will involve developing sophisticated algorithms for enhanced search and ranking in contact management, designing and building highly scalable distributed backend systems, and leveraging the latest in LLM technology to make Alexa's voice interactions more intuitive and natural. You'll collaborate across teams to solve complex technical challenges that span the entire Alexa ecosystem, ensuring that our users have the most seamless and efficient communication experience possible. This role is perfect for those who thrive on variety and want to see their code make a tangible impact on a product used by millions.

Our team is constantly evolving, embracing the latest advancements in LLM models and AWS technologies to delight customers with truly seamless, error-free, and conversational experiences. The new features we're developing with LLM will catapult Alexa's capabilities to unprecedented levels, making it a true powerhouse in natural communication. You'll be part of a team that's electrified by this pivotal direction, fueled by our latest engagement results and motivated to continually push the boundaries of what's possible. Join us on this exhilarating journey, where you'll be building LLM-powered distributed systems that enable world-class, highly scalable, and user-friendly solutions. As we aspire to connect people through Alexa like never before, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, constantly discovering and achieving new milestones in voice technology.

Don't miss this opportunity to be part of something truly remarkable. Apply now and unlock your potential with Alexa!

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

As a key member of the engineering team, you will have influence on our product and technology strategy by helping define the product features, refine system architecture, and spearhead best practices that enable a quality product. You will be working closely with LLM technologies in your day to day work.

You will be successfully setting up the architecture foundation for the next phase of the product and beyond. A commitment to teamwork, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. Creating a reliable, scalable, and high-performance service requires exceptional technical expertise, a sound understanding of the fundamentals of Computer Science, and practical experience building large-scale distributed systems.

You should enjoy working on complex system software, is customer-centric, and feels strongly about building good software as well as making that software achieve its operational goals.

A day in the life

Most of your day is writing code, running tests, and iterating.

When you hit a design decision, you write a short doc or sync with a teammate to align before going deeper. You review pull requests from others and get yours reviewed too. You push changes, monitor deployments, and fix anything that breaks.

Some days you join a quick sync with a product partner to clarify what needs to be built. You translate that into a technical plan and get back to coding.

About The Team

Our team owns multiple micro services and Language models responsible for finding the correct contacts and channel for establishing communication. Typical team structure involves Sr.SDEs, SDE2s and SDE1s. You will be working directly with PEs, PMs, TPMs and other related stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications

• 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
• 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
• Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

• 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

About the Role:

As a Senior Financial Planning Analyst, you will engage in more advanced financial tasks and provide significant support in the analysis and preparation of financial data. Your role will ensure that accurate financial insights are available for decision-making, aiding the organization's financial planning and analysis efforts efficiently.

Responsibilities:

• Produce comprehensive financial reports and analyses.
• Independently conduct financial forecasting and trend analysis.
• Develop and update complex financial models.
• Analyze profit-and-loss statements and provide recommendations.
• Research and analyze economic progressions impacting financial planning.
• Collaborate on the development of financial strategies.
• Support the preparation of budget proposals and schedules.
• Ensure accuracy and reliability of financial data and reports.
• Participate in scenario analysis for future business planning.
• Present financial insights to management as needed.

Skills:

• Comprehensive Data Analysis: Proficient in complex financial data analysis.
• Forecasting: Skilled in performing detailed financial forecasting.
• Advanced Modeling: Proficient in developing and updating complex financial models.
• Report Analysis: Ability to produce and interpret comprehensive financial reports.
• Strategic Insight: Providing insights based on financial data and trend analysis.
• Economic Research: Proficient in researching and analyzing economic trends.
• Scenario Planning: Assisting in "what if" scenario analyses for strategic planning.
• Presentation Skills: Capable of presenting financial data and insights effectively.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.
